ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
